articulation.label: food
articulation.alt: food: /f/ → /u/ → /d/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /f/: Upper teeth lightly touch the lower lip.
/u/: High back tongue; round the lips.
/d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: moon
articulation.alt: moon: /m/ → /u/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
/u/: High back tongue; round the lips.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: good
articulation.alt: good: /ɡ/ → /ʊ/ → /d/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /ɡ/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; add voice.
/d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: book
articulation.alt: book: /b/ → /ʊ/ → /k/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
/k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

cards.title: Five words to hear and use
sections: the part of a plant such as an apple that people eat. He does not buy any other fruit.
Light from the moon. We can see the water in the moonlight.
An object used to make or repair something. This tool can help us fix the chair.
After a short time. The bus will come soon.
Twelve o’clock in the middle of the day. We eat lunch at noon.
Listen to each word. Point or act to show its meaning. Say one word, then one short sentence. Ask for help with spelling patterns you have not learned yet.
